name: EH3D-NODE-BUNGARD-HMI
stack: C++17 (host-tested core); ESP-IDF 5.5 firmware with LVGL 9 for the ESP32-P4
build: cmake -S tests -B build/host && cmake --build build/host && ctest --test-dir build/host -C Debug
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: a 10.1-inch touch screen (Guition JC8012P4A1C, ESP32-P4) meant to control a Bungard CCD machine on its own, with the screens of the desktop programs in eight languages and spoken alerts and orders. The rules are in the host-tested core: the settings file with safe defaults, the gate that every move and spindle order passes (confirmation on the screen, hardware-stop latch, armed link), the spoken orders and alerts and the screen texts in eight languages. The ESP-IDF firmware with the LVGL screens is written but has not been built, flashed or run on a module; there is no link to the server or the machine yet and nothing has been connected to a machine.
